verdict.rationale: Brevo offers an MCP server and AI-tool management of "campaigns and contacts," and its UI supports filter-based segments. None of the evidence documents creating a filter-based segment through the API or MCP. Programmatic list organization and Aura AI's plain-language Q&A are adjacent features, not a way to turn a plain-language description into a real segment.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an agent can translate a plain-language audience description into a real segment via the platform's programmatic surface
